chunks: "Prostration upon the earth is an obligation, and upon other than the earth is a sunnah (recommended practice)."

key_terms.السُّجُودُ: prostration in worship, especially the sajdah of salat
key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground, the obligatory surface mentioned here for prostration
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a sunnah, here meaning a recommended or non-obligatory practice
key_terms.غَيْرِ: other than, indicating a distinction from the earth

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about performing sajdah on the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the proper basis of sajdah in salat. It distinguishes prostration on the earth as the obligatory norm, while prostration on other than the earth is described as sunnah.
